$comment: 02-plan/plan.graph.json — the build graph in machine form. The CONDUCTOR writes it at P2 and keeps it in step with plan.md and the briefs; scripts/plan-graph.mjs checks it (cycle, orphan or doubled AC, a file with two owners, a shared file outside the foundation, a used name with no producer, an edge that is not real behaviour, depth over target, size over the cap) and computes the waves, the width and the critical path. Stage 4 reads it for the start order.
acs: every AC id of 00-discovery/stories.md (<journey>.<step>.<n>), exactly as written there. Every one is carried by exactly one node.
shared: the doctrine's shared files (migrations, the contract, the generated code, the module registry) as globs. Only a foundation node owns them; no other node owns or extends them.

nodes[].kind: foundation (F, the thin serial head; F-b only when F splits) · lane (F-x<n>: foundation work nobody waits for, run beside the slices) · slice (E-<nn>: one vertical slice, one builder) · integration (E-int: the journeys that cross three or more slices, size S, merges last).

nodes[].after: only real behaviour. class 'ui' = a journey drives the other node's UI; class 'side-effect' = a check reads that node's real side effect. Data is a factory and an interface is a fake: neither is an edge. stacked: true = the node may start on the other's branch as soon as it is ready. Stage 4 stacks a node on one parent only: with two or more edges, it starts when all but one have merged.

nodes[].owns: the paths the node creates or edits (literal paths or dir/** globs; no two nodes overlap). extends: append-only additions to a file the foundation or an ancestor created, or to an existing append-safe file; the one replacement allowed is filling a stub F left, by exactly one node.
appendSafe: optional, the files several nodes extend on lines that never meet (one row per node in a feature map), each with why; the checker does not warn on them.
nodes[].provides / uses: the names that cross a node boundary, exactly as code imports or calls them. Every used name has one producer: the foundation, or an ancestor behind an edge.
nodes[].needs: optional, the P2 classification kept for the audit: {name, class: shared|data|interface|ui|side-effect|e2e, resolved: F | factory | fake | edge:<id> | E-int}.
size: S · M · L, and L is the cap (one screen with its states and one server flow, about 2,500 changed lines with tests). weights turn sizes into the critical path's length.
name: at most 8 words (the blueprint's cap), the same in plan.md, the brief and the blueprint.

checker: written at the close, never before: the path of the plan's checker in the pipeline repo and its git blob sha (git hash-object), the version whose green closed the plan. Stage 4 runs that version or reads a newer one's new rules as notes.

target.maxAcs: optional. Omitted, the checker's AC guide per slice is 8 scaled by the discovery's grain (ACs per journey step or frame state); over it is a warning: size the node by screens, flows and lines.

checker.blob: <git hash-object of plan-graph.mjs, at the close>

appendSafe.<docs/features/orders.md>: <one row per node: E-01 rows ORD-1..2, E-03 row ORD-3>

after.need: <the journey clicks 'Mark ready', which E-03 builds>
<the check reads the ready e-mail E-04 really sends>
